title: Precepts Generosity
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up precepts two and eight, not stealing and not being stingy with Dharma and money, working from a handout that sets five versions of each precept side by side. The evening begins with the green funeral of Kevin Bartlett earlier that day, where guests carried the shrouded body and filled the grave themselves. Nomon then tells of feeling greed rise while searching a University of Washington lost-and-found closet for a laptop part, and treats the precepts as tools for noticing such seeds sprouting. A Moth podcast story of nuns lying to protect children in wartime Marseille illustrates the literal, relative, and absolute levels of the precepts, and locking a door becomes a kindness that spares others temptation.
